description: This file contains utility functions for managing overlay filesystems in the build system, specifically for generating systemd unit names, escaping unit names, and handling overlay mount points.

methods.name: escapeSystemdUnitName(path)
methods.description: Escapes a systemd unit name by replacing certain characters with appropriate escape sequences.

methods.name: strForBash(s)
methods.description: Prepares a string for safe use in bash by escaping backslashes.

methods.name: allOverlaysUnitName(d)
methods.description: Generates the name for the overlays service unit based on the 'PN' variable.

methods.name: mountUnitName(unit)
methods.description: Generates the mount unit name for a given unit by escaping it and appending '.mount'.

methods.name: helperUnitName(unit)
methods.description: Generates a helper service unit name for a given unit, appending '-create-upper-dir.service' after escaping.

methods.name: unitFileList(d)
methods.description: Returns a list of overlay filesystem unit files based on given overlay mount points and writable paths, with validation checks.
